2619.def:
let FailFloor = 10;   // 10 = brute-force burst floor per account/host
let Fails = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "LogonFailed"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize FailedCount = count(), FailStart = min(Timestamp), FailEnd = max(Timestamp), SrcIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 15) by AccountName, DeviceName
    | where FailedCount >= FailFloor;
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner Fails on AccountName, DeviceName
| where Timestamp between (FailStart .. FailEnd + 30m)
| project SuccessTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FailedCount, SrcIPs, LogonType, RemoteIP
| order by SuccessTime desc
2619.sent:
let FailFloor = 10;   // 10 = brute-force burst floor per account/host
let Fails = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4625
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | summarize FailedCount = count(), FailStart = min(TimeGenerated), FailEnd = max(TimeGenerated), SrcIPs = make_set(IpAddress, 15) by TargetUserName, Computer
    | where FailedCount >= FailFloor;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4624
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where LogonType in (3, 10)   // network + RDP — remote password-guessing surface
| join kind=inner Fails on $left.TargetUserName == $right.TargetUserName, $left.Computer == $right.Computer
| where TimeGenerated between (FailStart .. FailEnd + 30m)
| project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, FailedCount, SrcIPs, LogonType, IpAddress
| order by SuccessTime desc
2619.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count as failures, min(_time) as fail_start, max(_time) as fail_end, values(Authentication.src) as src from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=failure by Authentication.user, Authentication.dest, _time span=1h
| `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`
| where failures >= 10
| join type=inner user, dest [| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as success_time from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=success by Authentication.user, Authentication.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)`]
| where success_time >= fail_start AND success_time <= fail_end+1800
| sort - success_time

``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Missed incidents, persistent threats, and response gaps: Insights from compromis ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("nei.bat","dl1host.exe","bat.bat","cmd.bat","taskhost.exe","poab.bat","load.bat","loab.bat","mance.exe","eter.exe","puls.exe","eternalblue2.dll","doublepulsar2.dll","http.sys","scrcons.exe") OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process_path="*C:\Windows\Fonts\Mysql*" OR Processes.process_path="*C:\Windows\System32\wbem*")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*C:\Windows\Fonts\Mysql*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*C:\Windows\System32\wbem*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/var/folders/*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("nei.bat","dl1host.exe","bat.bat","cmd.bat","taskhost.exe","poab.bat","load.bat","loab.bat","mance.exe","eter.exe","puls.exe","eternalblue2.dll","doublepulsar2.dll","http.sys","scrcons.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
| append [
  | tstats `summariesonly` count
      from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry
      where Registry.action IN ("created","modified")
        AND (Registry.registry_path="*HKU\\S-1-5-21-*" OR Registry.registry_path="*HKLM\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall*" OR Registry.registry_path="*HKLM\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall*")
      by Registry.dest, Registry.process_name, Registry.registry_path,
         Registry.registry_value_name, Registry.registry_value_data
  | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)`

2747.def:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let GitClones = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("git.exe","git") and ProcessCommandLine has "clone"
    | project GitTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, CloneCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ ("python.exe","python3","python","powershell.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("EXPLOIT_POC","exploit.py","poc.py")
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Downloads\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", "/tmp/", "/Downloads/")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner GitClones on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (GitTime .. GitTime + WindowSec*1s)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, CloneCmd, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, GitTime)
| order by Timestamp desc

    | where ActingProcessName has "git" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "clone"
    | project GitTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, CloneCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("python","powershell")
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("EXPLOIT_POC","exploit.py","poc.py")
